text_block_list.text:
While walking down the hallway,
I passed by a listless-looking Vodka...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Good grief. Lately,
my body's been feeling a bit sluggish...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Why? I haven't been staying up late,
and I've been eating properly too...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
—Gah, no good! If I keep sitting here whining,
it'll totally ruin my cool image!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I gotta cool my head for a bit.
Maybe I'll go wash my face or somethin'...

...It seems fatigue has built up.
Perhaps I should reconsider the race schedule.
